operations.comment: ; iNES header: "NES",$1A, 8 x 16 KiB PRG, no CHR ROM (8 KiB CHR-RAM), flags $21 =
; mapper 2 (UxROM) with vertical mirroring.
; PRG banks 0-3 ($8000-$BFFF when selected): 2bpp tile graphics, 16 bytes per tile,
; copied to CHR-RAM by LoadTileSet through TileSetDescriptors. The descriptor
; extents cover all of banks 0, 1 and 3 and bank 2 except the blank tile and the
; shared page noted below.
; PRG bank 1: tile graphics for LoadTileSet (see the bank 0 note).
; PRG bank 2 $8000-$8AEF: tile graphics for LoadTileSet.
; Bank 2 $8AF0: 16 zero bytes (one blank tile) not covered by any tile-set
; descriptor.
; PRG bank 2 $8B00-$B1FF: tile graphics for LoadTileSet.
; Bank 2 $B200-$B2FF: animated background tile frames for stage 5. Uploaded as
; tiles by descriptors and also streamed 64 bytes at a time into CHR tiles
; $F0-$FF by UpdateStageScenery (rotating window, phase from FrameCounter).
; PRG bank 2 $B300-$BFFF: tile graphics for LoadTileSet.
; Bank 3 $8000-$80FF: the same kind of animated tile frames for stage 6.
; PRG bank 3 $8100-$BFFF: tile graphics for LoadTileSet.
; PRG bank 4 (PRG_BANK_MAP): map graphics data plus metasprite sizes and palettes.
; Selected by DrawMapBlock, DrawMetasprite and LoadPalettes around each read.
; Bank4MapLayout $8000-$8E3F: the level map, one 32x32-pixel block id per byte.
; Each 256-pixel page is 64 bytes (8 columns x 8 rows); 57 pages ($00-$38),
; read by DrawMapBlock at $8000 + MapIndex. Pages 0-17, 18-33, 34-49 and 50-56
; use block ids up to 219/126/123/89, matching the four block sets below.
; Bank4BlockAttrSet0-3 $8E40-$9070: one attribute byte per block id for each of
; the four ScreenKind block sets (220, 127, 124 and 90 entries). DrawMapBlock
; indexes BlockAttrBaseLo/HiTbl by ScreenKind and adds the block id.
; Set 0: 220 attribute bytes (probably map pages 0-17).
; Set 1: 127 attribute bytes (probably map pages 18-33).
; Set 2: 124 attribute bytes (probably map pages 34-49).
; Set 3: 90 attribute bytes (probably map pages 50-56).
; Bank4BlockDefSet0-3 $9071-$B380: 16-byte block definitions (4x4 tile numbers,
; row by row) for the same four block sets; DrawMapBlock reads
; BlockDefBase[ScreenKind] + id*16. Each set has as many blocks as its
; attribute set.
; Set 0: 220 block definitions of 16 tile numbers.
; Set 1: 127 block definitions.
; Set 2: 124 block definitions.
; Set 3: 90 block definitions (ends at $B380).
; Bank 4 $B381-$B9FF: all-zero run between the last block set and the page-aligned
; metasprite tables; no reader found (probably fill).
; MsprWidthTbl $BA00: width of each metasprite frame in 8-pixel cells, indexed by
; ObjFrame (256 frames). DrawMetasprite reads it with bank 4 mapped.
; MsprHeightTbl $BB00: matching frame heights in cells. Width*height is the size
; of the frame's tile grid in bank-6 MsprFrameData.
; Bank 4 $BC00-$BFFF: 4-byte background/sprite palettes indexed by PaletteSel
; (LoadPalettes).
; PRG bank 5 (PRG_BANK_SOUND_COLL): terrain collision map and all sound data.
; Bank5CollisionMap $8000-$8E3F: terrain for GetTerrain, laid out like the bank-4
; map (57 pages x 64 bytes). Each byte covers one 16-pixel column of a 64-pixel
; band and holds four 2-bit cells (floor/wall bits, see TERRAIN_*).
; Bank 5 $8E40-$8FFF: zero run after the 57 collision pages; no reader found.
; SndLengthTbl $9000: note durations. Track bytes $80-$BF select an entry with
; AND #$3F in the track reader, so exactly 64 entries; the last few are zero.
; Bank 5 $9040-$90FF: zero run up to the envelope pointer table; no reader found.
; SndEnvPtrTbl $9100: 128 word pointers to volume envelopes, indexed by
; TrkEnvelope*2 in StartEnvelope; 72 entries are used (non-zero), all pointing
; into SndEnvelopeData.
; SndSeqPtrTbl $9200: 64 word pointers, one per sound number, read by StartSound
; (index = sound*2). Each points at a sound header in SndSequenceData.
; SndEnvelopeData $9280-$98EA: volume envelope byte streams stepped per frame by
; the envelope code of the sound driver (see StartEnvelope / StepEnvelope).
; SndSequenceData $98EB-$BC67: sound headers - (track number, data pointer)
; triples ended by a byte with bit 7 set, read by StartSound - followed by the
; track byte streams read by ReadTrackByte (notes, durations $80-$BF, commands
; $F0-$F9). The end is taken at the last non-zero byte; the exact end of the
; final stream was not proven.
; Bank 5 $BC68-$BFFF: zero tail of the bank; no reader found.
; MsprFramePtrTbl bank 6 $8000-$81FF: 256 little-endian word pointers, one per
; ObjFrame, read by DrawMetasprite (bank 6 is the normal game bank). All targets
; MsprFrameData bank 6 $8200-$90D7: metasprite frame grids, width*height tile
; numbers (sizes from MsprWidthTbl/MsprHeightTbl), row by row; 0 = empty cell,
; other values are added to ObjTileBase. Several frames share bytes: frames
; $E6-$EF all point at $8F8A and overlap the staff roll text, and $F0-$F5 are
; empty (0x0). No frame covers $8A1D-$8A40: 36 bytes found nowhere else in the
; ROM, with values $00-$40, empty cells and ascending tile runs, so probably an
; unused frame grid (6x6 or 4x9) rather than copied code. $8F89 is a single $00
; right after frame $D0, also the pointer target of the empty frames $D1-$E5.
; Both stay inside this block.
; Frames $F6-$FF: the staff roll, stored as ASCII codes used as tile numbers
; (the ending tile set presumably holds letters at those codes): "STAFF",
; "PRODUCER", "DIRECTOR", "PLANNER / DESIGNER", "COMPOSER", "SOUND EDITOR",
; "THANKS", "SPECIAL THANKS", "THANK YOU FOR PLAYING", "THE END", with names.
; UpdateEndingScene2 scrolls each frame up in slot 8 and steps ObjFrame from
; $F6 to $FF (seen in the round-1 ending run).
; Bank 6 code ($90D8-$BFE9) runs only with PRG bank 6 mapped at $8000.
; Object slots used by the gameplay code: 0 player, 1 player attack,
; 2 page guardian (the main enemy of a map page), 3 guardian attack,
